# House of Dimah

> House of Dimah is a branding, content and social media marketing team run by Chuks and Kat, working with businesses across London, Hampshire and Dorset. One team handles your brand, content and delivery every month.

## Services
- [Branding & Rebranding](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/branding-and-rebranding/): brand strategy, naming, logo and identity, guidelines, rebrands
- [Social Media Marketing](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/social-media-marketing/): social strategy, content calendar, account management, community, reporting
- [Content Creation](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/content-creation/): photography, video and reels, copywriting, editing
- [Website Design & Development](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/website-design-and-development/): site maps, UI design, build, SEO, care and updates
- [Communication Strategy](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/communication-strategy/): audience and message, tone of voice, channel plan, campaign planning
- [Marketing Consulting](https://houseofdimah.co.uk/services/marketing-consulting/): workshops, work reviews, direction
